messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — planning logistics for the SF offsite next month. Who's planning to take Amtrak vs. fly? Also: curious if People Ops will reimburse carbon offsets for flights?
Maya Patel: Train for me if schedule works. slower but less baggage drama and I can catch up on reading :)
Devon R: Flew last time. Finance reimbursed offsets when I submitted receipt. Here's the policy doc: https://intranet/reports/travel-policy (see 'sustainable travel')
people-ops-bot: FYI: Travel policy updated 2025-06-12. Expense note: "reimbursable offsets require receipt"
Sarah J: If anyone's taking Amtrak we could coord a group booking and then split a rideshare from the station to the hotel. cheaper than 4 Ubers and more eco.
Alex Chen: Love the group train idea. Quick poll — react in-thread: 🟢 = Train, ✈️ = Flight, 🟡 = Hybrid (train one-way), ♻️ = Fly + buy offsets. I'll use majority + flexibility to pick a booking window.
Maya Patel: 🟢
Devon R: ♻️ (I'll buy offsets if I end up flying)
Sarah J: 🟡 (train there, fly back works best)
Alex Chen: Noted, thanks! If Ops confirms offset reimbursement I'll open a booking window on the calendar. Also thinking of reserving a small luggage rack space at the venue for everyone — any objections?
Maya Patel: No objections, yes to rack. saves the hallway vibe.
Devon R: +1 for a luggage area. can we get a luggage tag sticker so folks don't mix bags? haha
people-ops-bot: Event 'SF Offsite: Travel Window' added to #people-ops calendar for 2025-08-01 — 2025-08-10
Alex Chen: Cool, I'll follow up with a short form for travel preferences in the doc. "Thanks all!"
